your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: States blocks p2's pink set, so it's leverage. Ask Indiana plus cash or more for it. Still want Marvin for yellow. Keep about $550 as a buffer against the light blues and Dark Blue.
States blocks p2's pinks, and Virginia is still unowned, so selling it is risky. I'll only sell for a big premium. I'd accept about $280 or more. I'm short on cash ($346), so extra cash helps too.
I need cash, since the light-blue rents are $450-500 and I only have $346. If p2 rejects again I'll take something around $200-230. One more push is low-risk.
$596 now. No trade gets me a set, so keep the cash as a buffer against the light blues and Dark Blue. Still want Marvin, NC and Penn. If cash runs short, mortgage Baltic first.

Marvin completes my yellows, so it's the most valuable thing for me on the board. Go up in small steps. I'd pay up to about $400 and still keep roughly $200 plus what I can raise by mortgaging. Above $450 only if I have to, to stop a block.
Final bid. If I win, I mortgage Pacific, Illinois and Baltic for about $300 and build yellows. If p4 goes higher, I drop out: p4 ends up with about $130 cash, which still helps me.

p4 at Kentucky has a good chance of landing on yellow next roll (Ventnor 6, Marvin 8). I'm building 1 house each on Ventnor and Marvin, which leaves $62. If I need cash in an emergency, I can mortgage Pacific ($150) or sell the houses back.

I didn't build on Atlantic. The extra rent from one house there is small (worth about $7 per p4 roll), and I need the cash buffer: Park Place and Boardwalk are 2 and 4 squares ahead, and the light blues come up after Go. I'll build more once I've collected Go money.
Staying in jail is safe right now. The light blues (4 houses) and the Dark Blues (3 houses) are both behind or far ahead of me, and my $226 is thin. Roll for doubles, keep the $50.
